tests.name: kernel_compact_symmetric
tests.reason: Check hand-computable Wendland values, strict compact support, and negative-coordinate symmetry.

tests.name: zero_b_and_no_support
tests.reason: Negative controls must not move free corners; signed-zero C bytes are retained.

tests.name: single_anchor_support_fade
tests.reason: Prevent accidental normalization to one outside dense support; near-radius response must fade.

tests.name: multiplicity_invariance
tests.reason: Uneven repeated source IDs must not increase their total influence.

tests.name: conflicting_copies_retained
tests.reason: Keep split proposal observations and allow opposing contributions to cancel instead of last-copy selection.

tests.name: dense_support_subconvex_bound
tests.reason: Dense support becomes a convex mean, sparse support stays subconvex, and the participating displacement norm bound holds.

tests.name: cap_after_FP32_rounding
tests.reason: Catch a real FP32 rounding overshoot of .02L and enforce the actual stored displacement bound.

tests.name: invalid_input_contracts
tests.reason: Reject dtype/scale/source-ID inconsistency and nonfinite geometry rather than silently changing definitions.

input_immutability: Read-only NumPy inputs and byte checks enforced in every successful fixture
